description: Comprehensive question bank derived from FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks notes. Covers Vocabulary, Grammar, Prepositions, Articles, Verbs, and exam methodology. Verify before formal examination use.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The synonym of 'brave' is ______.
questions.explanation: Brave means showing courage; courageous is its synonym.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A synonym of 'brief' is ______.
questions.explanation: Brief means short in duration or length; concise is its synonym.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The antonym of 'ancient' is ______.
questions.explanation: Ancient means belonging to the distant past; modern is its opposite.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The opposite of 'expand' is ______.
questions.explanation: Expand means to become larger; contract means to become smaller, making it the antonym.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The antonym of 'scarce' is ______.
questions.explanation: Scarce means insufficient or rare; abundant means plentiful, making it the antonym.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who writes poems is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A poet is a person who writes poems.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who cannot read or write is called ______.
questions.explanation: An illiterate person cannot read or write.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who speaks many languages is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A polyglot is a person who knows and is able to use several languages.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who studies plants is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A botanist is a scientist who studies plants.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A place where books are kept is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A library is a place where books are kept for reading or borrowing.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who loves mankind is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A philanthropist is a person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially through generous donations.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who looks at the bright side of things is called an ______.
questions.explanation: An optimist is a person who tends to be hopeful and confident about the future or the success of something.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Please ______ my invitation.
questions.explanation: Accept means to receive or agree to; except means excluding.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Everyone came ______ Ravi.
questions.explanation: Except means excluding; everyone came excluding Ravi.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The teacher gave me useful ______.
questions.explanation: Advice is a noun meaning guidance; advise is a verb meaning to give guidance.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The medicine may ______ your health.
questions.explanation: Affect is usually a verb meaning to influence; effect is usually a noun meaning result.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The ______ of the school addressed the students.
questions.explanation: Principal means head of a school or main; principle means a rule or belief.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Honesty is a good ______ to live by.
questions.explanation: Principle means a rule or belief governing behavior; principal means head or main.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The car remained ______ at the signal.
questions.explanation: Stationary means not moving; stationery means writing materials.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: I need to buy some ______ for the office.
questions.explanation: Stationery means writing materials; stationary means not moving.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Be careful not to ______ your keys.
questions.explanation: Lose means to fail to keep; loose means not tight.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The shirt is too ______ for me.
questions.explanation: Loose means not tight; lose means to fail to keep.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Please keep ______ in the library.
questions.explanation: Quiet means silent; quite means fairly or completely.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The movie was ______ interesting.
questions.explanation: Quite means fairly or completely; quiet means silent.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The red tie ______ your blue shirt well.
questions.explanation: Complement means to complete or go well with; compliment means praise.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She received a ______ on her excellent performance.
questions.explanation: Compliment means praise; complement means to complete or go well with.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She ______ attention to the lesson.
questions.explanation: The common collocation is 'pay attention'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: We experienced ______ rain during the monsoon.
questions.explanation: The common collocation is 'heavy rain'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He promised to ______ his promise.
questions.explanation: The common collocation is 'keep a promise'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: You should ______ a decision quickly.
questions.explanation: The common collocation is 'make a decision' (also 'take a decision' in some varieties).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Students should ______ their homework regularly.
questions.explanation: The common collocation is 'do homework'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Everyone makes a ______ sometimes.
questions.explanation: The common collocation is 'make a mistake'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The ______ wind blew the leaves away.
questions.explanation: The common collocation is 'strong wind'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The idiom 'once in a blue moon' means ______.
questions.explanation: Once in a blue moon means something that happens very rarely.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The idiom 'spill the beans' means ______.
questions.explanation: Spill the beans means to reveal secret information unintentionally or indiscreetly.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He ______ hard every day.
questions.explanation: A singular subject (He) takes a singular verb (works) in the simple present.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: They ______ hard every day.
questions.explanation: A plural subject (They) takes a plural verb (work) in the simple present.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Each student ______ a book.
questions.explanation: Each + singular noun takes a singular verb (has).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Neither of the answers ______ correct.
questions.explanation: Neither of + plural noun usually takes a singular verb in formal exam grammar.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The list of items ______ ready.
questions.explanation: The verb agrees with the real subject (list), not the nearby noun (items).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Neither the teacher nor the students ______ ready.
questions.explanation: With neither...nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject (students = plural).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Either the manager or the employees ______ responsible.
questions.explanation: With either...or, the verb agrees with the nearer subject (employees = plural).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Every child ______ to play.
questions.explanation: Every + singular noun takes a singular verb (loves).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She ______ every day.
questions.explanation: Habit or general truth uses simple present; singular subject takes 'reads'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: They ______ now.
questions.explanation: Action happening now uses present continuous tense (are studying).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He ______ yesterday.
questions.explanation: Completed past action with past time (yesterday) uses simple past (arrived).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She ______ the work already.
questions.explanation: Past action with present relevance/experience uses present perfect (has completed).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The train ______ before we arrived.
questions.explanation: Action completed before another past action uses past perfect (had left).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Ramesh and ______ went there.
questions.explanation: Subject pronoun 'I' is used when it is part of the subject of the sentence.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The teacher called ______.
questions.explanation: Object pronoun 'him' is used as the object of the verb 'called'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: This book is ______.
questions.explanation: Possessive pronoun 'mine' stands alone without a following noun.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: ______ house is very beautiful.
questions.explanation: Possessive adjective 'their' is used before a noun.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The house is ______.
questions.explanation: Possessive pronoun 'theirs' stands alone without a following noun.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is a ______ driver.
questions.explanation: Adjective 'careful' describes the noun 'driver'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He drives ______.
questions.explanation: Adverb 'carefully' modifies the verb 'drives'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She is a ______ student.
questions.explanation: Adjective 'diligent' describes the noun 'student'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She speaks English ______.
questions.explanation: Adverb 'fluently' modifies the verb 'speaks'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He was tired, ______ he continued working.
questions.explanation: 'But' expresses contrast between being tired and continuing to work.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He stayed home ______ he was ill.
questions.explanation: 'Because' expresses reason for staying home.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: ______ he was tired, he continued working.
questions.explanation: 'Although' expresses concession—despite being tired, he continued.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: You will fail ______ you work hard.
questions.explanation: 'Unless' means 'if not'—you will fail if you do not work hard.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: It was raining, ______ we stayed indoors.
questions.explanation: 'So' expresses result—because it was raining, we stayed indoors.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The meeting will begin ______ 10 a.m.
questions.explanation: 'At' is used for exact clock time.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: We will meet ______ Monday.
questions.explanation: 'On' is used for days and dates.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: My birthday is ______ June.
questions.explanation: 'In' is used for months, years, seasons and longer periods.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: India became independent ______ 1947.
questions.explanation: 'In' is used for years.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She has worked here ______ 2020.
questions.explanation: 'Since' identifies a starting point in time.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He has lived here ______ ten years.
questions.explanation: 'For' identifies a duration of time.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Submit the assignment ______ Friday.
questions.explanation: 'By' means not later than a deadline.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Wait ______ 5 p.m. before leaving.
questions.explanation: 'Until/till' means up to a time.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Please do not talk ______ the meeting.
questions.explanation: 'During' means within a period or event.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The train arrives ______ noon.
questions.explanation: 'At' is used with certain fixed points like 'at noon'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She is waiting ______ the bus stop.
questions.explanation: 'At' is used for a point or specific location.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The children are playing ______ the room.
questions.explanation: 'In' is used for inside an area or enclosed space.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The book is ______ the table.
questions.explanation: 'On' is used for a surface.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The cat jumped ______ the box.
questions.explanation: 'Into' expresses movement from outside to inside.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He climbed ______ the roof.
questions.explanation: 'Onto' expresses movement to a surface.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: We walked ______ the road to reach the other side.
questions.explanation: 'Across' means from one side to another.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The train went ______ the tunnel.
questions.explanation: 'Through' expresses movement within or inside something.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The park is ______ the two buildings.
questions.explanation: 'Between' is used for separating two entities.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She was the best ______ the candidates.
questions.explanation: 'Among' is used for within a group.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She sat ______ the window.
questions.explanation: 'Beside' means next to.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: ______ English, she knows Kannada and Hindi.
questions.explanation: 'Besides' means in addition to.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is good ______ mathematics.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'good at'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She is interested ______ classical music.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'interested in'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The child is afraid ______ dogs.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'afraid of'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: We depend ______ our parents for support.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'depend on'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: This book belongs ______ my sister.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'belong to'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Please listen ______ me carefully.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'listen to'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: You should apologise ______ your mistake.
questions.explanation: Apologise for (something); apologise to (someone).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The committee consists ______ ten members.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'consist of'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He suffers ______ asthma.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'suffer from'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The doctor prevented him ______ smoking.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'prevent from'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She insisted ______ paying the bill.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'insist on'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: I prefer tea ______ coffee.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'prefer X to Y'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She is married ______ a doctor.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'married to'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is capable ______ handling the project.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'capable of'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Your answer is similar ______ mine.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'similar to'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: This design is different ______ that one.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is 'different from' (also 'than' in some varieties).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: They arrived ______ Bengaluru late at night.
questions.explanation: Arrive in a city or country; arrive at a small/local place.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: We arrived ______ home late.
questions.explanation: Arrive home is normally used without at/in.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Let us discuss ______ the matter tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Discuss a matter (not discuss about a matter).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She entered ______ the room quietly.
questions.explanation: Enter a room (not enter into a room in ordinary usage).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: ______ the rain, the match continued.
questions.explanation: Despite/in spite of are followed by a noun phrase; although is followed by a clause.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: ______ it was raining, the match continued.
questions.explanation: Although is followed by a clause; despite/in spite of are followed by a noun phrase.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She prefers coffee ______ tea.
questions.explanation: Prefer X to Y is the standard construction.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: This model is superior ______ that one.
questions.explanation: Superior to is the correct fixed expression (not superior than).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is junior ______ me in the office.
questions.explanation: Junior to is the correct fixed expression (not junior than).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She is senior ______ him by two years.
questions.explanation: Senior to is the correct fixed expression (not senior than).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Divide the sweets ______ the children.
questions.explanation: Among is used within a group; between is for two entities.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.4

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is ______ honest officer.
questions.explanation: Honest begins with a vowel sound because h is silent, so 'an' is used.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 4.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She studies at ______ university.
questions.explanation: University begins with the consonant /y/ sound, so 'a' is used.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 4.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: I ate ______ apple.
questions.explanation: Apple begins with a vowel sound, so 'an' is used.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 4.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He waited for ______ hour.
questions.explanation: Hour begins with a vowel sound because h is silent, so 'an' is used.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 4.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She bought ______ one-rupee coin.
questions.explanation: One begins with the consonant /w/ sound, so 'a' is used.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 4.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is ______ MBA student.
questions.explanation: MBA starts with the vowel sound /em/, so 'an' is used.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 4.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She is ______ European tourist.
questions.explanation: European begins with the consonant /y/ sound, so 'a' is used.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 4.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She is ______ doctor.
questions.explanation: A/an can introduce a profession; doctor begins with a consonant sound.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 4.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: I saw a dog. ______ dog was black.
questions.explanation: The is used for a previously mentioned noun.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 4.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: ______ sun rises in the east.
questions.explanation: The is used with unique things in the relevant context (the sun).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 4.2

questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.1

questions.explanation: A botanist is a scientist who studies plants.

questions.explanation: A library is a place where books are kept for reading or borrowing.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who loves mankind is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A philanthropist is a person who seeks to promote the welfare of others.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who looks at the bright side of things is called an ______.
questions.explanation: An optimist is a person who tends to be hopeful and confident about the future.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.2

questions.explanation: Accept means to receive or agree to; except means excluding.

questions.explanation: Advice is a noun meaning guidance; advise is a verb meaning to give guidance.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The medicine may ______ your health.

questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The ______ of the school addressed the students.

questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Honesty is a good ______ to live by.
questions.explanation: Principle means a rule or belief governing behavior; principal means head or main.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.question: The car remained ______ at the signal.

questions.explanation: Stationery means writing materials; stationary means not moving.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.question: Be careful not to ______ your keys.

questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The shirt is too ______ for me.
questions.explanation: Loose means not tight; lose means to fail to keep.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.question: Please keep ______ in the library.
questions.explanation: Quiet means silent; quite means fairly or completely.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.explanation: Quite means fairly or completely; quiet means silent.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 1.3

questions.question: The red tie ______ your blue shirt well.
questions.explanation: Complement means to complete or go well with; compliment means praise.

questions.question: She received a ______ on her excellent performance.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: They ______ hard every day.
questions.explanation: A plural subject (They) takes a plural verb (work) in the simple present.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Each student ______ a book.
questions.explanation: Each + singular noun takes a singular verb (has).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Neither of the answers ______ correct.
questions.explanation: Neither of + plural noun usually takes a singular verb in formal exam grammar.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The list of items ______ ready.
questions.explanation: The verb agrees with the real subject (list), not the nearby noun (items).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Neither the teacher nor the students ______ ready.
questions.explanation: With neither...nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject (students = plural).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Either the manager or the employees ______ responsible.
questions.explanation: With either...or, the verb agrees with the nearer subject (employees = plural).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Every child ______ to play.
questions.explanation: Every + singular noun takes a singular verb (loves).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She ______ every day.
questions.explanation: Habit or general truth uses simple present; singular subject takes 'reads'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: They ______ now.
questions.explanation: Action happening now uses present continuous tense (are studying).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He ______ yesterday.
questions.explanation: Completed past action with past time (yesterday) uses simple past (arrived).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She ______ the work already.
questions.explanation: Past action with present relevance/experience uses present perfect (has completed).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The train ______ before we arrived.
questions.explanation: Action completed before another past action uses past perfect (had left).
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: I ______ you tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future prediction or decision uses will + base verb.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Ramesh and ______ went there.
questions.explanation: Subject pronoun 'I' is used when it is part of the subject of the sentence.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.question: The teacher called ______.

questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: This book is ______.
questions.explanation: Possessive pronoun 'mine' stands alone without a following noun.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: ______ house is very beautiful.
questions.explanation: Possessive adjective 'their' is used before a noun.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The house is ______.
questions.explanation: Possessive pronoun 'theirs' stands alone without a following noun.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is a ______ driver.
questions.explanation: Adjective 'careful' describes the noun 'driver'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He drives ______.
questions.explanation: Adverb 'carefully' modifies the verb 'drives'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She is a ______ student.
questions.explanation: Adjective 'diligent' describes the noun 'student'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She speaks English ______.
questions.explanation: Adverb 'fluently' modifies the verb 'speaks'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He was tired, ______ he continued working.
questions.explanation: 'But' expresses contrast between being tired and continuing to work.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He stayed home ______ he was ill.
questions.explanation: 'Because' expresses reason for staying home.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: ______ he was tired, he continued working.
questions.explanation: 'Although' expresses concession—despite being tired, he continued.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: You will fail ______ you work hard.
questions.explanation: 'Unless' means 'if not'—you will fail if you do not work hard.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: It was raining, ______ we stayed indoors.
questions.explanation: 'So' expresses result—because it was raining, we stayed indoors.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 2.3

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The meeting will begin ______ 10 a.m.
questions.explanation: 'At' is used for exact clock time.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: We will meet ______ Monday.
questions.explanation: 'On' is used for days and dates.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: My birthday is ______ June.
questions.explanation: 'In' is used for months, years, seasons and longer periods.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: India became independent ______ 1947.
questions.explanation: 'In' is used for years.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She has worked here ______ 2020.
questions.explanation: 'Since' identifies a starting point in time.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He has lived here ______ ten years.
questions.explanation: 'For' identifies a duration of time.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Submit the assignment ______ Friday.
questions.explanation: 'By' means not later than a deadline.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Wait ______ 5 p.m. before leaving.
questions.explanation: 'Until/till' means up to a time.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Please do not talk ______ the meeting.
questions.explanation: 'During' means within a period or event.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The train arrives ______ noon.
questions.explanation: 'At' is used with certain fixed points like 'at noon'.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.1

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She is waiting ______ the bus stop.
questions.explanation: 'At' is used for a point or specific location.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The children are playing ______ the room.
questions.explanation: 'In' is used for inside an area or enclosed space.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.question: The book is ______ the table.
questions.explanation: 'On' is used for a surface.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.question: The cat jumped ______ the box.
questions.explanation: 'Into' expresses movement from outside to inside.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He climbed ______ the roof.
questions.explanation: 'Onto' expresses movement to a surface.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.question: We walked ______ the road to reach the other side.
questions.explanation: 'Across' means from one side to another.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The train went ______ the tunnel.
questions.explanation: 'Through' expresses movement within or inside something.
questions.source: FDA/SDA General English - 17.13 Fill in the Blanks, Section 3.2

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The park is ______ the two buildings.
questions.explanation: 'Between' is used for separating two entities.
